mission: Consume the existing f16 Linux-proxy evaluation artifacts to identify the single worst meaningful slice with N>=5 across the cascade, then root-cause EVERY failure in that slice with per-failure forensics, pin reproducible failures as regression fixtures where defensible, and implement fixes only if defensibly general.

sliceSelection.selected: BALL stage, OBSERVED bucket of the D2-06 hard-slice gold (N=35)
sliceSelection.rationale: The named D2-06 hard slices are each below N=5 except fastBlur (N=6, 0 hits), which is a subgroup of the same corpus; the OBSERVED bucket is the smallest meaningful cross-case slice with N>=5 that contains all of them. At the f16 artifact it measured hits 4/35; re-measured at the Wave C integration head (after the f08 fixes) it is hits 9/35 - still by far the weakest N>=5 metric on the scoreboard (ownership, contact, phase, stroke proxies are all far stronger per their artifacts). All forensics below are against the head measurement, not the stale artifact.

method: Re-ran the real tracker (buildBallTracks -> selectPrimaryBallTrack) over the committed e12 Linux motion candidates exactly as the hard-slice eval does, then for EVERY OBSERVED failure recorded: the eval outcome, raw candidate evidence within +/-40ms of the gold time, the 'carrier' track holding a gold-aligned observation (with itemized stage-C gate and primary-eligibility scorecards), what the primary emitted instead, a mechanical stage classification, and two measured counterfactuals: goldAlignedCount (how many golds a perfect gate/selection fix could recover from that track) and wouldWinSelectionIfGated (re-running primary selection with the carrier force-included).

datasetScope.grouping: per-source-session cases; per-label forensics grouped by mechanical failure stage and by carrier track (failures sharing a carrier share a root cause)
datasetScope.denominators: the committed 35 OBSERVED gold labels; nothing resampled, no labels added or removed

holdoutStatement: The held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were not touched, read, listed, or referenced by any code or analysis in this workstream.

configuration.platform: LINUX-CPU pose-free proxy (Apple Vision pose and paddle track unavailable; canonical Mac strict cascade remains blocked - no Mac/iPhone/Swift numbers are claimed)
commands: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check

measuredResults.evidencePresence: 26/26 failures had a raw motion candidate within the hit radius at +/-40ms of the gold time (candidate generation is NOT the bottleneck on this slice)

counterfactuals.gateOnlyFix: of the 19 GATE_REJECT failures, force-gating the carrier track in made it win primary selection in only 1 case (wavea-sasebo-volleys t=52553, a 1-gold carrier that also fails maxSpeed); for the three dominant ghost-flight carriers (6, 7 and 7 gold-aligned observations) selection still preferred the incumbent primary - a gate-only relaxation recovers at most ~1/19
counterfactuals.selectionOnlyFix: the 5 SELECTION_LOSS carriers are gated-in mixed/limb tracks each carrying exactly 1 incidentally gold-aligned observation; selecting them would emit wrong locations across the rest of their windows

findings: The dominant root cause (19/26) is 'ghost flights': association DOES build tracks carrying up to 7 gold-aligned observations, but stage-C gates reject them - jerkyFraction fails on genuine direction changes at bounce/hit (afn-sasebo-rally2 trk jerky=0.467 vs max 0.34; wavea-wgm-wheelchair jerky=0.400) and chronicFraction fails where real flight crosses chronically-active background cells (rally2 chronic=0.630, wavea-sasebo-volleys chronic=0.769 vs max 0.60).

Fixing gates alone would NOT fix the slice: measured counterfactuals show the ghost-flight tracks still lose primary selection even when force-gated in, so recovery needs a coupled gate + selection-score change. On N=4 cases, tuning both against this locked eval would be exactly the repeated-tuning-against-locked-tests failure mode the program forbids.
5/26 SELECTION_LOSS failures are incidental single-point overlaps of gated limb/mixed tracks with early flight - not recoverable by selection changes without emitting wrong locations elsewhere.

2/26 ASSOCIATION_DROP failures (wavea-wgm-wheelchair t=182800/182867, post-hit blur) have strong raw detections (distance 0.002/0.005 from gold) that never join a >=3-observation chain - the per-frame displacement of the fast ball exceeds the association gate; N=2 is too small to justify a gate-radius change.
The f16 BALL artifact (hits 4/35) is stale relative to head (hits 9/35 after the f08 fixes); the scoreboard's OCCLUDED violations are also gone at head (2/2 abstained).

No production change is defensible from this evidence; the failures are pinned as regression fixtures instead (packages/swing-lab/test/g17BallHardSlicePin.test.ts): the exact head aggregate (9/35, zero violations) plus the three ghost-flight signatures (gold-carrying track exists, is gate-rejected, and loses selection even if force-gated). A future ball fix must consciously flip these pins.
artifacts: datasets/experiments/wave-g/g17-forensics-evidence.json (all 26 per-failure records with scorecards and counterfactuals)
verdictRationale: The mission (worst-slice identification + per-failure forensics on all 26 failures + defensible regression pins) is complete with measured evidence, and the root causes are now precisely localized (stage-C jerky/chronic gates plus selection scoring, not candidate generation). YELLOW rather than PROVISIONAL_GREEN because the slice itself remains weak (9/35 OBSERVED hits) and no general fix could be honestly shipped from N=4 cases; YELLOW rather than RED because zero abstention violations remain, misses are honest (no decoy emission), and the forensics + pins give the next wave an exact, reproducible target.
